superflexFoldsIntoQb records the OWNER decision (#839 wording) that a Superflex
slot is real QB demand and is added to QB dedicated demand BEFORE the multiplier.
It reproduces the owner's own worked example: 1 QB + 1 SF -> base 2 ->
ceil(1.5 x 2) = 3 meaningful QBs. See the lane doc for the assumption it carries.
